summary: Add a read-only, local-only project catalog and a local-only HTTP dashboard over monag's existing observations

delivery.outcome: Add a `monag catalog` subcommand: for one repository (--root is a checkout), or every repository under --root, reports what each project declares itself to be (description, stack, entry points, docs/tests/changelog presence, last commit) read verbatim from its own manifests and README -- no network calls, no LLM-generated text. Add a `monag panel` subcommand: a local-only HTTP dashboard (default 127.0.0.1:8090) serving the existing agent/repository snapshot and Planfile backlog on a background refresh timer, plus the audit/catalog reports computed lazily and cached on first request.
nonGoals: No network calls (no gh/GitHub API metadata) and no LLM summarization in `catalog`; an undeclared description is reported as unknown, never guessed.
No browser, password-manager, or session credential access of any kind, anywhere in this ticket.
No write access to any scanned repository.
`panel` binds to 127.0.0.1 by default and serves only monag's own existing read-only reports; it adds no new data source and no authentication (not a public-facing service).

architecture.decision: Add src/monag/catalog.py reusing audit.py's repository-discovery (targets()) plus local manifest/README parsing (pyproject.toml, package.json, README.md); wire a new `monag catalog` subcommand and JSON/Markdown reporting following the resume/audit conventions. Add src/monag/panel.py: stdlib http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer (no new runtime dependency) serving a static HTML page plus /api/*.json endpoints backed by monitor.snapshot()/resume.scan() (background-refreshed) and audit.scan()/catalog.scan() (lazily computed, TTL-cached); wire a new `monag panel` subcommand.
architecture.rollback: Revert the application slice through protected review.

validation.evidence: Catalog module, panel module, and CLI wiring regression suite passes.
